name: @limio/ot-quote-builder
description: OpenText Trading Grid Enterprise self-serve quote builder. The buyer describes their trading network, picks a term and add-ons and gets a priced quote (live catalog prices from the page's offers and add-ons) with a quote reference. Submitting sends a Limio data_capture order; the Salesforce v3 plugin turns it into an i42as__OrderEvent__e (DATA_CAPTURE) and Apex creates the Account, Contact, Opportunity and Limio quote. Needs an auth provider on the page (anonymous auth).

limioProps.label: Intro
limioProps.default: Tell us about your trading network and get a priced quote in minutes. No call needed.

limioProps.label: Base plan (tier_rank__limio of the Trading Grid offer to quote on)
Managed services option
limioProps.default: Managed services: OpenText runs your B2B operations (priced by your account team)

limioProps.label: Success body
limioProps.default: We've sent it to your account team. They'll confirm it and send you a link to accept and pay.

limioProps.label: Small print under the summary
limioProps.default: List prices, excluding tax. Your account team confirms the quote, including any multi-year or managed-services pricing.
